notes.title: Update Log: Gameplay Balance & QoL
notes.content:
Jump back into Popcorn Fever! We’ve balanced powers for more strategic play and added some quality-of-life tweaks:

Power Adjustments:

Fireball needs more fusions to activate.
Timebomb slightly adjusted.
x2, Payday, Pop It, and Poppy Rain are easier to achieve.
QoL:

Right-click to swap symbols
